description: Defines the DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator class for managing database permissions and schema modifications within the OrangeHRM system, including creating tables, CRUD operations, schema alterations, foreign key management, and permission evaluation.

classes.name: DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator
classes.description: A class for evaluating and managing database permissions, schema modifications, and foreign key constraints within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the evaluator with a database connection.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Returns the SchemaHelper instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: evalCreatePermission
methods.description: Creates a temporary table with various columns to test create permissions.

methods.name: evalCrudPermission
methods.description: Performs CRUD operations and validation on the temporary table to test permissions.

methods.name: evalAlterPermission
methods.description: Alters the schema of the temporary table by adding, changing, renaming, and dropping columns.

methods.name: evalForeignKeyPermission
methods.description: Creates foreign key constraints, inserts related data, and tests foreign key permissions.

methods.name: evalDropPermission
methods.description: Drops temporary tables and foreign key constraints to test drop permissions.

methods.name: evalPrivilegeDatabaseUserPermission
methods.description: Runs a sequence of permission evaluations including creating, altering, foreign key management, and dropping tables.
